name: airtable
description: Read and write Airtable bases and records using a personal access token. Load for record lists, filtered queries, reads, and creates/updates.

content.inline:
## Airtable
Calls go through `v/ops/http/get` / `v/ops/http/post` against `https://api.airtable.com/v0` with `bearerSecret: "s/AIRTABLE_TOKEN"` (a personal access token from airtable.com/create/tokens; grant the specific bases and `data.records:read`/`:write` scopes needed). Only the secret reference goes in the request.

Common calls:
- List bases: `GET https://api.airtable.com/v0/meta/bases`
- Base schema (tables & fields): `GET https://api.airtable.com/v0/meta/bases/{baseId}/tables`
- List records: `GET /{baseId}/{tableIdOrName}?pageSize=100` (page with `offset`; filter with `filterByFormula`, e.g. URL-encoded `{Status}='Open'`)
- One record: `GET /{baseId}/{tableIdOrName}/{recordId}`
- Create: `POST /{baseId}/{tableIdOrName}` body `{records: [{fields: {...}}], typecast?: true}`
- Update: `POST /{baseId}/{tableIdOrName}` with `method: "PATCH"` and body `{records: [{id, fields: {...}}]}`

Rules:
- Check `status`; errors are `{error: {type, message}}`. 401 = bad token; 403 = base/scope not granted; 422 = a field name or type is wrong (read the schema first).
- `baseId` starts `app...`, record ids start `rec...`; table can be its name or `tbl...` id. URL-encode names with spaces and any `filterByFormula` (`v/ops/jvm/url-encode`).
- Max 10 records per create/update call; batch larger writes.
